steps.name: Run the two exact on-demand Store controls
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
output="$RUNNER_TEMP/store-custody"
mkdir -p "$output"
git rev-parse HEAD | tee "$output/source.txt"
test "$(cat "$output/source.txt")" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
rustc --version | tee "$output/rustc.txt"
grep -E '^rustc 1\.97\.1 \(' "$output/rustc.txt"
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --lib host::runtime::tests::custody:: -- --list 2>&1 | tee "$output/list.txt"
grep -Fx 'host::runtime::tests::custody::actual_store_destruction_keeps_the_original_native_owner_until_inner_retires: test' "$output/list.txt"
grep -Fx 'host::runtime::tests::custody::single_injected_store_inner_panic_retains_owner_and_poisons_only_test_cohort: test' "$output/list.txt"
test "$(grep -Ec '^[A-Za-z0-9_:]+: test$' "$output/list.txt")" -eq 2
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --lib host::runtime::tests::custody:: -- --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$output/result.txt"
grep -Fx 'test host::runtime::tests::custody::actual_store_destruction_keeps_the_original_native_owner_until_inner_retires ... ok' "$output/result.txt"
grep -Fx 'test host::runtime::tests::custody::single_injected_store_inner_panic_retains_owner_and_poisons_only_test_cohort ... ok' "$output/result.txt"
grep -F 'test result: ok. 2 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$output/result.txt"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)"
